_comment: Questions a company settles before it issues passports, shown on every product group's checklist (/product-groups/[key]/checklist). Written by hand from how the software works, not from any act: each 'why' restates something the home page or the passport check already says (import from CSV/Excel incl. ERP exports; signature checked against an identity on your web domain; key generated and held on your infrastructure; runs on your infrastructure or a cloud you control; restricted parts released on a credential; a passport stays available for years after sale). Keep them questions, never obligations.

questions.q: Where does this product data live today?
questions.why: Spreadsheets, a product or ERP system, or supplier documents. The node imports CSV and Excel files, including exports from an ERP.

questions.q: Which of your web domains will carry your company's identity?
questions.why: Anyone who checks a passport checks its signature against an identity published on your own web domain.

questions.q: Who in your company may sign passports?
questions.why: The signing key is generated and held on your own infrastructure, so someone has to be responsible for it.

questions.q: Who will run the node, and where?
questions.why: It runs on your own infrastructure, or on a cloud you control.

questions.q: Who will ask to read the parts that are not public?
questions.why: Repairers, recyclers and authorities read those parts, each on a credential.

questions.q: Who keeps the passports available after the product is sold?
questions.why: A passport has to stay available for years after the product is sold.
